That same amount is the direct-reserve denominator; independently reproduced division yields 100% ZSD, without adding an inferred residual or changing the category. The snapshot reports 165790931896668830 circulating ZYS atoms and a pricing-record yield_price of 1980817660000 atoms, or 1.98081766 ZSD per share. Their product is 328,401.6057687789136355378 ZSD, 0.1142615879133644622 ZSD below the reserve. This observed difference is retained and no exact liability reconciliation or independent-explorer corroboration is asserted. Pinned protocol code calculates yield price from the ZSD yield reserve divided by native yield-share supply. Underlying ZSD backing remains an upstream dependency.
